q: I wouldn't worry if __________.
e: Second conditional-এ if clause-এ Past Simple ও মূল clause-এ would/could/might + base verb বসে, যা অবাস্তব বা কাল্পনিক অবস্থা বোঝায়। এই বাক্যে মূল clause I wouldn't worry, তাই if অংশে past form লাগবে। কাল্পনিক শর্তে be verb সব person-এর সঙ্গে were হয়, তাই I were you শুদ্ধ। উদাহরণ: If I won a lot of money, I'd buy a big house। সম্পূর্ণ বাক্য: I wouldn't worry if I were you।

q: If I had seen the warning signs, I __________ differently.
He _____ killed if he had violated the rules.
If the weather had been better, we ________ sailing.
If you studied harder, you ___________ better grades.
If I had known it was your birthday, I _______ you a gift.
If I had seen him, ____________.
o: I have told him the news.
I might tell him the news.
I might have told him the news.
I have telling him the news.

q: If I had known the truth, I ______ differently.
Which sentence is the correct one?
o: If I had a virtuous friend, he would guide me to the right path.

If I had a virtuous friend, he would guided me to the right path.

q: Had the driver been careful, the accident _____ avoided.
Choose the correct replacement for the underlined portion of the sentence: Had the team worked harder , they could have won the game.
o: If the team had worked harder
Had the team be worked harder
Had the team been worked harder

q: If she _______ the warning, she _______ trouble.
He commands me as if he ________ my boss.
Find out the correct sentence.
o: If I were a bird, I would fly to you.
If I was a bird, I would fly to you.
If I am a bird, I would fly to you.
If I were a bird, I will fly to you.
e:
বর্তমানে অসম্ভব বা কাল্পনিক শর্ত বোঝাতে Conditional-এ 'if' clause-এ সব Subject-এর সঙ্গে 'were' বসে, এমনকি 'I'-এর সঙ্গেও। Main clause-এ তখন 'would/could/might + verb' থাকে।
মনে রাখুন:
অসম্ভব শর্তের কাঠামো: If + Subject + past form (were), Subject + would + verb।
উদাহরণ:
If he were here, he would help us.

q: Mishu walks as if he _______ drunk.
Choose the correct sentence.
o: No sooner had I seen Maria then she had started laughing.
No sooner had I seen Maria than she started laughing.
No sooner had I saw Maria then she had started laughing.
No sooner had I seen Maria than she had started laughing.
